scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Torrhen begins his voluntary dispersion into the planetary matrix, and the Sage recognizes the necessity of universal service over personal preservation.

scene_meta.focus: Three days after dissolution begins, Torrhen guides the Sage through the transition of personal identity into universal service; the Sage learns he must become the living embodiment of integrated synthesis.
scene_meta.continuity: 3 days after dissolution begins in scene 022.1
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Torrhen instructs the Sage on transferring individual wisdom into universal access as his bio-form grows translucent.

scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen (dissolving into planetary matrix)

scene_meta.continuity: 7 days after dissolution begins in scene 022.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Torrhen's final merger into stone and water, and the Sage's solemn acceptance of solitary stewardship.

scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage conducts his first solo teaching, demonstrating integrated synthesis by helping Aethon master trauma-triggered power.

scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the exponential expansion of the Sage's synthesis teaching network across species and dimensions.

scene_meta.focus: One year before the Great Convergence, the Sage foresees future foundational teachers growing up in simple rural harmony and prepares to seek them out, carrying Torrhen's eternal partnership within his integrated consciousness.
